#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate forest plot of HS precision advantage over text probes (Figure 2).

Data source: Table 2 (tab:hs_vs_text) in experiments.tex.
Output: docs/paper/figures/fig_forest_precision.pdf
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

models = ["R1-8B", "OT-7B", "QwQ-32B", "R1-32B"]

data_384d = {
    "delta": [20.1, 21.9, 19.2, 15.4],
    "ci_lo": [12.4, 14.4, 9.3, 8.7],
    "ci_hi": [28.3, 29.6, 33.5, 22.6],
    "hb":    [True, True, True, True],
}

data_1024d = {
    "delta": [5.8, 18.1, 9.4, 11.7],
    "ci_lo": [-7.4, 8.4, -7.1, -0.2],
    "ci_hi": [19.5, 29.0, 27.7, 24.3],
    "hb":    [False, True, False, False],
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.0))

y_positions = np.arange(len(models))
offset = 0.15

for i, model in enumerate(models):
    for enc_idx, (enc_data, color, label_prefix) in enumerate([
        (data_384d, "#1f77b4", "MiniLM-384d"),
        (data_1024d, "#ff7f0e", "BGE-1024d"),
    ]):
        y = y_positions[i] + (offset if enc_idx == 0 else -offset)
        delta = enc_data["delta"][i]
        lo = enc_data["ci_lo"][i]
        hi = enc_data["ci_hi"][i]
        hb = enc_data["hb"][i]

        marker = "D" if hb else "D"
        facecolor = color if hb else "white"
        ax.errorbar(
            delta, y,
            xerr=[[delta - lo], [hi - delta]],
            fmt="none", ecolor=color, capsize=3, capthick=1.2, linewidth=1.2,
        )
        ax.plot(
            delta, y,
            marker="D", markersize=6,
            color=color, markerfacecolor=facecolor,
            markeredgewidth=1.2, markeredgecolor=color,
            zorder=5,
        )

ax.axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--", zorder=0)

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel(r"$\Delta$ Precision (pp, HS $-$ Text)", fontsize=12)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=10)

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="#1f77b4", markerfacecolor="#1f77b4",
           markersize=6, linewidth=1.2, label="vs. MiniLM-384d"),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="#ff7f0e", markerfacecolor="#ff7f0e",
           markersize=6, linewidth=1.2, label="vs. BGE-1024d"),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="gray", markerfacecolor="white",
           markeredgewidth=1.2, markersize=6, linestyle="None",
           label="Hollow = fails HB"),
]
ax.legend(
    handles=legend_elements,
    fontsize=8.5,
    loc="upper left",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),
    framealpha=0.9,
    edgecolor="0.8",
)

ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(-15, 40)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()

out_path = "docs/paper/figures/fig_forest_precision.pdf"
fig.savefig(out_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}")

out_png = out_path.replace(".pdf", ".png")
fig.savefig(out_png, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved: {out_png}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate forest plot of HS precision advantage over text probes (Figure 2).

Data source: Table 2 (tab:hs_vs_text) in experiments.tex.
Output: docs/paper/figures/fig_forest_precision.{pdf,png}
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

models = ["R1-8B", "OT-7B", "QwQ-32B", "R1-32B"]

data_384d = {
    "delta": [20.1, 21.9, 19.2, 15.4],
    "ci_lo": [12.4, 14.4, 9.3, 8.7],
    "ci_hi": [28.3, 29.6, 33.5, 22.6],
    "hb":    [True, True, True, True],
}

data_1024d = {
    "delta": [5.8, 18.1, 9.4, 11.7],
    "ci_lo": [-7.4, 8.4, -7.1, -0.2],
    "ci_hi": [19.5, 29.0, 27.7, 24.3],
    "hb":    [False, True, False, False],
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

y_positions = np.arange(len(models))
offset = 0.18

for i, model in enumerate(models):
    for enc_idx, (enc_data, color) in enumerate([
        (data_384d, "#1f77b4"),
        (data_1024d, "#ff7f0e"),
    ]):
        y = y_positions[i] + (offset if enc_idx == 0 else -offset)
        delta = enc_data["delta"][i]
        lo = enc_data["ci_lo"][i]
        hi = enc_data["ci_hi"][i]
        hb = enc_data["hb"][i]

        facecolor = color if hb else "white"
        ax.errorbar(
            delta, y,
            xerr=[[delta - lo], [hi - delta]],
            fmt="none", ecolor=color, capsize=4, capthick=1.5, linewidth=1.5,
        )
        ax.plot(
            delta, y,
            marker="D", markersize=8,
            color=color, markerfacecolor=facecolor,
            markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=color,
            zorder=5,
        )

ax.axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--", zorder=0)

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel(r"$\Delta$ Precision (pp, HS $-$ Text)", fontsize=14)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=11)

legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="#1f77b4", markerfacecolor="#1f77b4",
           markersize=8, linewidth=1.5, label="vs. MiniLM-384d"),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="#ff7f0e", markerfacecolor="#ff7f0e",
           markersize=8, linewidth=1.5, label="vs. BGE-1024d"),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="D", color="gray", markerfacecolor="white",
           markeredgewidth=1.5, markersize=8, linestyle="None",
           label="Hollow = fails HB"),
]

    handles=legend_elements,
    fontsize=11,
    loc="upper left",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),
    framealpha=0.9,
    edgecolor="0.8",
)

ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(-15, 40)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()

out_path = "docs/paper/figures/fig_forest_precision.pdf"
fig.savefig(out_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}")

out_png = out_path.replace(".pdf", ".png")
fig.savefig(out_png, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved: {out_png}")
